description: This file defines the MethodInfo class, which models a method with its name, return type, parameters, and signature construction logic within the Android apkcheck tool. It provides methods for generating method signatures, adding parameters, and normalizing type descriptors.

classes.name: MethodInfo
classes.description: A container class representing a method's signature, including its name, return type, parameters, and related utility methods for signature generation and type normalization.

methods.name: MethodInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the method's name and return type, also setting up an empty parameter list.

methods.name: getNameAndDescriptor
methods.description: Generates and returns the method's signature string, combining the method name, parameters, and return type descriptors.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter's human-readable type to the method's parameter list, invalidating the cached signature if necessary.

methods.name: normalizeTypes
methods.description: Converts the method's return type and parameter types to unambiguous binary type descriptors using the provided ApiList.
